bugClass.title: Singleton segmented controls inherit unintended active styling
bugClass.cause: A shared CSS selector targets an active button when it is the only child, causing singleton segmented groups to receive styling intended for a different state or context. The selector does not account for independent groups or the state-specific visual treatment required by the viewport.
bugClass.criteria: Match when a stylesheet has a singleton structural selector such as :only-child or :only-of-type combined with active/selected state and segmented-control button styling, and that rule can override state-specific styling across independently rendered groups. Each conflicting singleton selector is sufficient; neutral singleton styling without a state conflict does not match.
